ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Binary Proxy Execution Via Cdb.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of "cdb.exe" to launch arbitrary processes or commands from a debugger script file

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cdb\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "CDB\.Exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-cf\\ .*")))
